capabilities: Check installed plugins and themes for updates in the background
Show release notes for new versions
Install one update or all updates
Roll a plugin back to an earlier release
Flag removed, stale or manually installed plugins
disambiguation: Not an updater for Obsidian itself; it only checks the community plugins and themes installed in the vault.
extras: Sends web requests to GitHub only, with no analytics; the README lists each request and how to turn checking off. Updating relies on Obsidian's internal plugin installer, which is not part of the public API. An optional one-time-payment companion, Update Radar Pro, adds pre-update copies, restore points and a search for the plugin that breaks something; the features described in the README stay free.
intentEvidence: A successor to Plugin Update Tracker, which has not had a release in over a year.
problem: Obsidian only looks for plugin updates when you open Settings → Community plugins → Check for updates, so updates go unnoticed while you work.

relations.evidence: A successor to Plugin Update Tracker, which has not had a release in over a year.

summary: Background checker for community plugin and theme updates that shows release notes, flags abandoned plugins, and can install or roll back versions.
